```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
Influenza data, 2021-2026, retrieved from UKHSA

```{r}
influenza <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-flu.csv")

gt(head(influenza))

```

Plotting HSA influenza data
```{r}
influenza <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-flu.csv")
ggplot(influenza, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "cadetblue1") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Percentage") +
  ggtitle("Percentage of positive test results for influenza")
  
```




Download data via an API
```{r}
library("httr2")
```
```{r}
url <- "https://api.ukhsa-dashboard.data.gov.uk/themes/infectious_disease/sub_themes/vector_borne/topics/lyme/geography_types/Nation/geographies/England/metrics/lyme_cases_infectionRateByYear"
url <- paste0(url, "?page_size=365")
print(url)
```
```{r}
#set up request
api_request <- request(url)
#perform request
response <- req_perform(api_request)

#convert to JSON
json_response <- resp_body_json(response)
str(json_response, max.level = 1)

#Convert to dataframe
results_df <- bind_rows(json_response$results)
gt(head(results_df))
```
```{r}
print(unique(pull(results_df, stratum)))
print(unique(pull(results_df, age)))
print(unique(pull(results_df, sex)))

```
Filtering to select a single data series
```{r}
filt <- filter(results_df, stratum == "default")
filt <- filter(results_df, age == "all")
filt <- filter (results_df, sex == "all")
gt(filt)
```
